title: Vibrant Garlicky Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A garlicky and cozy Argentinian dish featuring tender beef skewers, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. The miso-marinate and cornstarch add a unique twist to the traditional recipe.
instructions: Preheat the tava-griddle to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, garlic, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso-marinate.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the tava-griddle with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Cook the beef skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Vibrant Garlicky Argentinian Beef Skewers hot with your favorite sides.
